lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the dark torso; spacing is largely equidistant, narrowing slightly toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Visible bifurcation on the third and fourth lines from the posterior, where segments merge approximately 40% down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Fragmented line segments observed near the anterior shoulder region and lower ventral edge of the mid-torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping of 3-4 distinct white spots located on the lower posterior flank near the junction of the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a posterior-facing vector at approximately 35 degrees relative to the snout-axis, exhibiting minimal lyrate curvature.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Terminal tip distance is approximately 1.2 times the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15% of the distal horn structure exhibits high-intensity white/ivory pixels relative to the dark base.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white horizontal patch on the lower neck and a prominent white chevron marking across the bridge of the nose.
